LAKE GARDA, ITALY'S HIDDEN PARADISE

Yes, a paradise.
There is no better place than Lake Garda for cycling lovers. The breathtaking scenery and unparalleled natural beauty guarantee all enthusiasts an unforgettable time of complete and utter freedom

During this trip, you will experience cycling in one of Europe’s top destinations while fully immersing yourself in authentic Italian culture and cuisine.

Every day is unique around the lake — with diverse routes that take you through olive groves, vineyards, and picturesque towns framed by sparkling waters and majestic mountains. The mild climate and well-maintained roads make it ideal for riders of all levels.

What truly makes this trip special is the optional day trip to Passo dello Stelvio — Italy’s greatest climb and one of the most iconic cycling ascents in the world.

This Lake Garda cycling experience is sure to exceed your expectations. It’s the perfect blend of adventure, culture, and natural beauty — a cycling holiday you’ll remember forever.

What's included

  • 5 Nights in beautiful self-catering apartments resort overlooking the lake, Relais Rosa Dei Venti
  • 6 Days of spectacular cycling
  • Airport transfers including bike and luggage transfers at the below details. Private transfers can be also organised at a supplement.
  • All ground transportation to the different restaurant each evening
  • Every day guided cycling routes by our ex pro, experienced and friendly guides.
  • One day full PRO experience with back up vehicle during the loop of the lake (Day 5)
  • Pro tips by out ex-pro staff
  • GPX files sent in advance

What's not included

  • Flights ​
  • Meals
  • Single room (in a shared two bedroom apt) limited availability at €150 extra​.
    Possibility of also to have your own apartment at €450 extra. Limited availability
  • Bike rental from €260 for the entire trip
  • Optional Stelvio day trip €90
  • Travel insurance

Airport transfers:

07/09

14:00pm from BGY Airport (Milan Bergamo) to accommodation

 

12/09

14:00pm from accommodation to BGY Airport (Milan Bergamo)

TRIP AT GLANCE

START & FINISH LOCATION: Moniga Del Garda

DAYS RIDING: 6 days

TOTAL DISTANCE: 497 km

GROUP SIZE: 15/20 max (2 groups on the road each day divided based on abilities)

LEVEL: Open to anybody

LONGEST DAY: Day 5 - Loop of the Lake

ROUTE

DAY TO DAY BREAKDOWN

GPX files will be sent before the trip.

DAY TO DAY BREAKDOWN


GPX files will be sent before the trip.

ARRIVAL DAY AND SIRMIONE

35 km | 250 m After arrival and after having some lunch, when everybody is ready and have finished adjusting the bikes, we head out for a 35km spin to Sirmione peninsula.

TREMOSINE - STRADA DELLA FORRA

100 km | 1,300 m Today we head to the west side of the lake where we climb the most beautiful climb of the lake towards Tremosine. On these roads, the James Bond movie was shot. At the top, we have some lunch in the beautiful terrace restaurant. After that, we head back.

PASSO DELLO STELVIO OR OPTIONAL DAY

45 km | 1,530 m 

Today if there is an optional day-trip to Italy's greatest climb: Passo Dello Stelvio.
We climb from the most popular side, Prato.
It is a 3.5 hrs drive out and then 3.5 hrs back. 25km of climb, 48 switchbacks to 2757mt of altitude.

Those not fancy Stelvio, would have another optional route in Lake Garda.

THE INLAND

85 km | 300 m On today's ride we head to the inland of Lake Garda and we cover some beautiful and quiet roads.

LOOP OF THE LAKE

145 km | 500 m The longest day in terms of distance. 145km around the Lake clockwise. An incredible route, mostly flat, with unparalleled scenery.

COFFE RIDE

50 km | 120 m

On the last day, before catching the flight back, we head on the west side of the Lake for a short ride and get a nice coffee/lunch on the waterfront.

FANCY A FEW DAYS ON GRAVEL?

This road trip runs alongside our Lake Garda Gravel tour, and both groups share the same accommodation and evening restaurants.

Want to swap in a gravel day or two instead of road?

You can rent a gravel bike just for the day — just let us know when booking.

Riders on both trips ride together off the bike, so you get the best of both worlds without picking just one.

PREVIOUS TRIPS GALLERY

OPTIONAL DAY-TRIP TO PASSO DELLO STELVIO ON DAY 3

Challenge yourself on one of the most legendary climbs in the world — the iconic Passo dello Stelvio. With its breathtaking hairpin bends and stunning alpine scenery, this epic ascent is a must for any serious cyclist. Whether you’re aiming to conquer the summit or simply soak in the incredible views, this day-trip offers an unforgettable experience that perfectly complements your Lake Garda adventure.

ACCOMODATION

RELAIS ROSA DEI VENTI

Located on a wide green area, and surrounded by big olive trees. It is just 200 metres from the shores of Lake Garda, and each apartment has a lake-view patio or balcony. The resort is made up of numerous self-catering apartments, located in different buildings. Common facilities include an outdoor swimming pool, a garden with children's playground. Parking is free. Every apartment has a comfortable living room, and a kitchen. All accommodation comes with air conditioning, a satellite TV with DVD player, and a private bathroom with bath or shower. The new tourist harbour and the beach, are about a 2-minute walk away. The town's historic centre is a 5-minute walk.

BIKE RENTAL

There are many options available, depending on your measures and budget we work with you to find the best bike for you. From standard mechanical groupset and alloy wheels to electric shifting and carbon wheels.

Road E-Bikes are also available.

FRAMESET Bianchi, Guerciotti, Wilier, De Rosa, Ktm

GRUPPO: Sram Rival/Force AXS, Shimano 105, Ultegra, Durace Di2 and Mechnical

PEDALS: Bring your own

SADDLE: Selle Itala

WHEELSET:  Alloy, Carbon

Do I need to bring my own bike, or can I rent one?

You’re welcome to bring your own bike, or rent one for the week. After booking, you will receive a form to fill out via email. You can let us know there and in the case you want to rent, you will see an option to fill up details for your measurements. 

What fitness level do I need for this trip?

This trip suits Beginner, Intermediate and Expert riders. The core Lake Garda routes are approachable for most fitness levels — the optional Stelvio day is the only day that demands solid climbing fitness, however is optional.

Are support vehicles included?

On the Lake Garda tour, we offer the support van on the loop of the lake day. Of course, in the Stelvio day, the van will carry your descending gear and jacket and will be at the top. 

Is there a single room supplement?

Yes, a single room supplement applies if you want a private room in a shared two bedroom apartment. There is also the option to have your own apartment.
